industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd. functions primarily as an electricity producer harnessing sustainable energy sources. Its operational scope encompasses the generation of power from wind, solar, and hydroelectric facilities. Beyond its core power production, the company also engages in strategic investments, handles project execution, and oversees the development and application of water resources. Furthermore, it extends technical advisory services. Originally operating under the name China Three Gorges New Energy (Group) Co., Ltd., the enterprise adopted its current identity, China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd., in June 2019. Founded in 1985, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, China.
